title: Extra-Crunchy Buttermilk Onion Rings with Horseradish Dip
summary: Thick onion rings are dipped twice in buttermilk and shaken in seasoned flour, cornflour and baking powder for a shaggy coating, fried at 190 °C and served with a horseradish mayonnaise.
equipment: large paper bag or lidded box
large Dutch oven or deep heavy pan

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dip
steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, horseradish, lemon juice and cayenne and chill.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Warm the oven to 100 °C, pour the buttermilk into a bowl and put the seasoned flour mixture in a bag.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Slice the onions 1 cm thick and keep the rings wider than 5 cm.

steps.title: Coat twice
steps.text: Dip the rings in buttermilk and shake in the flour bag, then repeat for a thick crust.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry in three batches at 190 °C for 3-4 minutes until deep golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain, keep warm in the oven and serve hot with the dip.

tips: The double coat is what gives the extra crunch.
Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot.
Separate rings that stick before they go into the oil.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best fried and eaten the same day. Cool leftovers, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 2 days, re-crisped in a 200 °C oven for 6-8 minutes until piping hot.
